title: Franca pack description (pack.yaml)
description: The language of a pack and the definitions that the rest of the pack refers to: its varieties, speakers, paradigm cells, verb classes, word decks, the learner goals in the pack and the exams a learner can name. Imported into catalogue_pack, catalogue_pack_version, catalogue_variety and the matching _v tables.

productive.description: true: learners are taught to speak and write this variety.

receptive_from.description: The level from which learners hear and read this variety.

voice.description: synthetic voices are labelled as such wherever they are heard.

paradigm_cell.description: A cell in an inflection table, for example present.2sg.inverted, past.pl or plural. The cells are shown in the order given.

ud_feats.description: Universal Dependencies features, for example Number=Plur|Tense=Past.

deck.description: A themed word deck, such as the words in a picture dictionary page.

goal.description: A learner goal in this pack. The goal keys belong to the app and are listed in study_goal. The pack has a name for each goal and a flag for whether it is offered.

exam.description: An exam a learner can name as a target. With available: false, the exam is listed as coming after this release.

checked_on.description: The day the details were last checked, as YYYY-MM-DD.

level_exam.description: The course node with the matching level exam.

language.description: The ISO 639 code of the language, for example nl.

version.description: The version of the pack, as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

script.description: The ISO 15924 code of the script, for example Latn.

typology.description: Facts about the language that matter for how it is taught, for example word order, gender or tone. They are read by the course design rules. They are not imported into the database. They are kept in the pack file, and where the app reads them from is worked out in story E03-002.

fonts.description: The fonts for this language in the interface. They are not imported into the database. They are kept in the pack file, and where the app reads them from is worked out in story E03-002.

reading_aids.description: Aids offered while reading, such as a transliteration or tone marks. They are not imported into the database. They are kept in the pack file, and where the app reads them from is worked out in story E03-002.

confusable_pairs.description: Pairs of items that learners often confuse, practised together in the mixed run.
